notes.title: The Dark Ocean Depths Greets Best Indie Games Summer Showcase!
notes.content:
Greetings, divers!

Headquarters is excited to announce that our upcoming atmospheric horror game Cold Abyss is a part of [url=https://www.youtube.com/@ClemmyGames]ClemmyGames' Best Indie Games Summer Showcase[/url]!

To celebrate this showcase, we're also [b]reopening the demo for you to explore the depths.[/b] 

[previewyoutube=d5wNKWRlDU4;full][/previewyoutube]

Remember, your job is to fix the cables down at the bottom of the ocean. Don't worry, you won't have any coworkers around. A perfect day of solitude.

[h3]➡️➡️[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3518690/Cold_Abyss_Directors_Cut_Demo/]Play the demo NOW![/url][/b][/h3]

notes.title: Demo Update Ver 1.1
notes.content:
Attention, divers!

Headquarters at Tachibana Heavy Industries has demanded we address some of the issues you encountered during your time on the ocean floor. 

Our technical team has managed to resolve the following:
[list]
[*] Unable to return to the main menu after finishing the demo, [b]fixed[/b]
[*] Unable to repair the cables using a controller, [b]fixed[/b]
[/list]
We would like to remind you that once you've entered our service, you may find it difficult to leave. 

Being trapped in the depths is only an illusion... or is it?

(jk we'll fix it so you can exit the game asap we swear)

~ Neon Doctrine

notes.title: 🌊🦑Cold Abyss Reveal - Solitude in Submerged Serenity.
notes.content:
[h3]We're excited to share that the expanded version of Cold Abyss is officially coming to Steam![/h3]

This version is packed with:
🔹 New levels and an expanded story
🔹 Improved graphics and smoother movement
🔹 All-new collectibles to discover

If you’re ready to escape to the loneliest (and most peaceful) place on Earth, hit that wishlist button—it helps more than you know!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3260040/Cold_Abyss_Directors_Cut/

(P.S. Publishing a game about walking along the ocean floor means I have to go diving for research, right? Asking for science. 😉)


[i]Your job is simple: fix some internet cables. 
The catch? They’re underwater. 
Very. Deep. 
Underwater.[/i]

[previewyoutube=cNILJNNxCW8;full][/previewyoutube]
